anchor_energy: E_{\mathrm{anchor}} = \sum_{(i,j) \in L} k \left(\frac{d_{ij} - t_{ij}}{t_{ij}}\right)^2 + w_b \sum_{(i,j) \in B} \left(\frac{d_{ij} - b_{ij}}{\min(d_{ij}, b_{ij})}\right)^2 \qquad + w_g \sum_{w \in W} n_w \left(\frac{R_g(w)}{R_w} - 1\right)^2 + w_{ev} \sum_{|i - j| > 1} \left(\frac{r_0 - d_{ij}}{r_0}\right)_{+}^{2}
chain_energy: E_{\mathrm{chain}} = \sum_i w_d k \left(\frac{d_{i,i+1} - t_i}{t_i}\right)^2 + \sum_i w_a \left(\frac{1 - \cos\theta_i}{2}\right)^3 \qquad + \sum_{(i,j) \in C} w_m \left(\frac{1 + \mathbf{o}_i \cdot \mathbf{o}_j}{2}\right)^2 + w_{ev} \sum_{|i - j| > 1} \left(\frac{r_0 - d_{ij}}{r_0}\right)_{+}^{2} + w_c \sum_i \left(\frac{r_i - R}{R}\right)_{+}^{2}
